gym.name: Gym Membership
gym.blurb: You paid for the membership, so you will go at least twice.

doctor_visit.name: Doctor's Visit
doctor_visit.blurb: A stranger poked you, pronounced you mostly fine, and billed you for it.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.blurb: You sat very still and thought about nothing, which you are told is the point.

library.name: Library Visit
library.blurb: Free books, a silence you respect, and a reminder that you once meant to read more.

vacation.name: Vacation
vacation.blurb: A week somewhere warm, followed by a credit card statement that ruins the glow.

plastic_surgery.name: Plastic Surgery
plastic_surgery.blurb: You now look like a more expensive version of yourself, give or take a face.

lottery_ticket.name: Lottery Ticket
lottery_ticket.blurb: A small bet on a future you will not get, bought with the usual optimism.

casino.name: Casino Night
casino.blurb: The house always wins, but tonight you were the house for a few minutes.

therapy.name: Therapy
therapy.blurb: You paid a stranger to listen to your childhood, and it was worth every cent.

diet.name: Diet
diet.blurb: Three weeks of salad, one weekend of regret, and a vague sense of self-control.

party.name: Party
party.blurb: You arrived early, stayed late, and cannot remember who the host was.

volunteer.name: Volunteer Work
volunteer.blurb: You gave up a free afternoon, which is the most expensive kind of kindness.

night_class.name: Night Class
night_class.blurb: Evening lectures on a subject you chose for reasons that seemed good at the time.

spa.name: Spa Day
spa.blurb: Someone rubbed your shoulders for an hour and you briefly forgot your mortgage.

tattoo.name: Tattoo
tattoo.blurb: A permanent decision made by an excellent sense of humour and a bad sense of timing.

skydiving.name: Skydiving
skydiving.blurb: You jumped out of a perfectly good plane, which the parachute company is grateful for.

movie.name: Movie Night
movie.blurb: Two hours in the dark, a large popcorn, and a sequel nobody asked for.

concert.name: Concert
concert.blurb: You screamed the lyrics, lost your voice, and will hear a faint ringing till Tuesday.

road_trip.name: Road Trip
road_trip.blurb: Four hundred miles, one terrible gas station burrito, and a playlist you regret.

karaoke.name: Karaoke
karaoke.blurb: You sang with total confidence and a complete absence of pitch.

nightlife.name: Nightlife
nightlife.blurb: You will be tired for three days and call it a good time.

pray.name: Pray
pray.blurb: Free of charge, and nobody can prove it did not help.

rehab.name: Rehab
rehab.blurb: Expensive, unpleasant, and exactly what everyone suggested.

shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.blurb: You needed nothing and left with four bags.

zoo_trip.name: Zoo Trip
zoo_trip.blurb: The animals looked at you with the same enthusiasm you looked at them.

garden.name: Gardening
garden.blurb: Something grew. Mostly weeds, but it counts.

read_book.name: Read a Book
read_book.blurb: You made it past the first chapter, a personal best.

walk.name: Go for a Walk
walk.blurb: You went outside and came back. Nothing happened, which was the point.

martial_arts.name: Martial Arts
martial_arts.blurb: You learned to fall properly, which is most of it.

voice_lessons.name: Voice Lessons
voice_lessons.blurb: Your teacher says you have potential. Your neighbors disagree.

acting_lessons.name: Acting Lessons
acting_lessons.blurb: You pretended to be a tree and were told you were convincing.

modeling_lessons.name: Modeling Lessons
modeling_lessons.blurb: You learned to stand still with intent.

instrument_practice.name: Practice an Instrument
instrument_practice.blurb: The same eight bars, again, until the family begged you to stop.

memory_test.name: Memory Test
memory_test.blurb: You forgot your result on the way home.

barber.name: Haircut
barber.blurb: Fifteen minutes, one mirror, and a sincere "just a trim".

hair_dye.name: Dye Your Hair
hair_dye.blurb: A bold new color and a permanent stain on the bathroom towel.

massage.name: Massage
massage.blurb: Someone found the knot you have been carrying around since January.

nail_salon.name: Nail Salon
nail_salon.blurb: Ten small improvements that will chip by Thursday.

tanning.name: Tanning
tanning.blurb: You are now a warmer shade of regret.

waxing.name: Waxing
waxing.blurb: Brief, smooth, and deeply insulting to your nerves.

sweepstakes.name: Enter Sweepstakes
sweepstakes.blurb: You filled out forms for a prize that probably does not exist.

horse_races.name: Horse Races
horse_races.blurb: You picked the horse with the best name. Statistics were unimpressed.

fight_betting.name: Fight Betting
fight_betting.blurb: You have strong opinions about two strangers hitting each other.

space_camp.name: Space Camp
space_camp.blurb: A week of freeze-dried food and real rocket science. Helps if you ever apply to the program.
